units.source_text: 本回写源氏三十七岁冬天至三十八岁冬天之事。

en.t: This chapter recounts events from the winter when Genji was thirty-seven to the winter when he was thirty-eight.

units.source_text: 玉鬘当了尚侍而尚未晋谒皇上之前，髭黑大将与她发生了关系。

en.t: After Tamakazura became Naishi no Kami, but before she had been formally presented to the emperor, General Higekuro had relations with her.
